title: Mixing: Looking Over From My Hotel Window, Is Winter Here To Stay? by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Two songs on Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe were mixed on 27 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘Looking Over From My Hotel Window’ had been recorded on 25 November. This day’s mixes were unused, however, as it was remixed on the 28th.

‘Is Winter Here To Stay?’ was recorded on 15 November, and the final mix was made on this day.
